about: The game's names by address, for the log readers, one target a DLL under the DLL's file name: functions and globals map an address to its name; parameters map a function's address to each argument's position in its entry row (param_N at N; in a thiscall, this at 1 and param_N at N + 1) and its name; extents map a named function's address to the code it covers, each range from a block's first instruction to the address of its last, for the return addresses rows carry. A rename is one edit here.
